rationale: Adds a test-only emitter conformance gate: four committed DesignIR fixtures are built through the native materializer, the ui.js bridge program, the baked C++ exporter (generated at build time by a test tool) and the SwiftUI exporter, and their anchored-view projections are compared with an allowlist of known gaps. No production source changes; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
